DropCountDef.description:
How many of the item one drop gives: a whole number from ``min`` to ``max``, each as likely. A ``min`` of 0
sometimes gives none, as vanilla's witch drops 0 to 2 glowstone dust; Looting's extra still counts then.
DropCountDef.title: DropCountDef

GearDef.description:
What makes the item a piece of gear (architecture 13): its kind and slot, its durability, how it is enchanted
and repaired, and its fixed stats, vanilla attribute modifiers with one id per slot and modifier
(``realmforge:gear/<slot>/<n>``, architecture 8.2). Gear stacks to 1.

attack_damage.description: A wand's attack damage, as its tooltip shows it (a bare hand is 1). Wands only, and required.
attack_damage.title: Attack Damage

attack_speed.description: A wand's attacks per second, as its tooltip shows it (a bare hand is 4). Wands only, and required.
attack_speed.title: Attack Speed

durability.description: Uses before it breaks (vanilla's max damage).
durability.title: Durability

enchantability.description: Vanilla's enchantment value: higher gets better enchantments at the table (iron armor 9, gold tools 22). Unset: the enchanting table refuses it. A wand takes the durability enchantments (Unbreaking, Mending), armor those of its slot's vanilla armor.
enchantability.title: Enchantability

equip_sound.description: Armor only: the sound of putting it on, leather's by default.
equip_sound.title: Equip Sound

kind.description: wand: a caster's weapon, its stats in the main hand only, worn down by every spell its holder casts and every hit, as a sword by hits; head, chest, legs, feet: armor worn in that slot, worn down by hits taken.
kind.title: Kind

anyOf.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.

look.description: Armor only, and required: how it looks worn, assets/realmforge/equipment/<look>.json, shared by a set (spellweave). Its texture is a placeholder in the item's colour until the set's art exists.
look.title: Look

modifiers.description: Its fixed stats while in its slot, e.g. {attribute: realmforge:spell_power, operation: add_value, amount_percent: 15}.
modifiers.title: Modifiers

anyOf.description: An item (minecraft:stick) or an item tag (#minecraft:wool). Validated against the ID universe.

repair_with.description: The material that repairs it in an anvil: an item (realmforge:spellweave) or an item tag ('#minecraft:stone_tool_materials'). Unset: only two of it combine.
repair_with.title: Repair With

GearDef.title: GearDef

GearModifierDef.description:
A fixed stat the gear gives while it is in its slot: a wand in the main hand, armor where it is worn. Units
follow the stat rules: ``add_value`` on one of our stats takes its unit (``amount_percent`` for a share, ``amount``
for points); multiplied operations take ``amount_percent``.

amount_percent.description: The amount in percent (5 means 5 %, the fraction 0.05).
amount_percent.title: Amount Percent

attribute.description: The attribute it modifies, e.g. realmforge:strength.
attribute.title: Attribute

operation.description: How the amount applies (vanilla's attribute modifier operations).
operation.title: Operation

GearModifierDef.title: GearModifierDef

ItemDropDef.description:
The item dropped by a mob that is not ours (a vanilla witch): added to the mob's own loot by a NeoForge loot
modifier, which leaves its loot table as it is. Our own mobs list their drops in their ``loot``
(``content/mobs/``).

chance_percent.description: The chance it drops at all, in percent: 100 by default.
chance_percent.title: Chance Percent

count.description: How many: from min to max, 1 by default.

looting_chance_percent.description: Each level of Looting adds this much to the chance, in percent points.
looting_chance_percent.title: Looting Chance Percent

looting_count.description: Each level of Looting adds 0 to this many more of the item (vanilla's 0 to 1 for most drops).
looting_count.title: Looting Count

ItemDropDef.title: ItemDropDef

LocalizedText.description: A player-facing text, keyed by locale. Realmforge ships English only, so en_us is the one locale.
LocalizedText.title: LocalizedText

ShapedRecipeDef.description:
A shaped crafting recipe that makes the entry: its rows of the crafting grid and the ingredient each character
stands for.

category.description: Its tab in the recipe book.
category.title: Category

key.description: Character -> the ingredient it stands for, e.g. S: minecraft:stone_bricks or W: '#minecraft:wool'. Every character is used.

^\\S$.description: An item (minecraft:stick) or an item tag (#minecraft:wool). Validated against the ID universe.

key.title: Key

pattern.description: Rows of the crafting grid, top to bottom, all the same width; a space is an empty slot: ["SSS", "S#S"].
pattern.title: Pattern

ShapedRecipeDef.title: ShapedRecipeDef

ShapelessRecipeDef.description: A shapeless crafting recipe that makes the entry: its ingredients go anywhere in the grid.

category.description: Its tab in the recipe book.
category.title: Category

ingredients.description: One entry per grid slot it fills (1 to 9), repeated for two of the same: ['#minecraft:wool', '#minecraft:wool', minecraft:iron_ingot].

items.description: An item (minecraft:stick) or an item tag (#minecraft:wool). Validated against the ID universe.

ingredients.title: Ingredients

ShapelessRecipeDef.title: ShapelessRecipeDef

SmithingRecipeDef.description:
A smithing table upgrade that makes the entry from ``base``, as vanilla's diamond-to-netherite upgrade: the
result keeps the base's enchantments, damage and name.

base.description: The item it upgrades, e.g. realmforge:diamond_wand.
base.title: Base

SmithingRecipeDef.title: SmithingRecipeDef

description:
A simple item. Generates its registration, model, lang entries and (for now) a placeholder texture; a use and a
flavor line become its tooltip, a recipe its recipe, and gear its durability, slot and fixed stats.

color.description: Main colour of its placeholder texture, "#RRGGBB"; by default a colour from a hash of its id.
color.title: Color

creative_tabs.description: Creative mode tabs to list the item in, e.g. minecraft:ingredients. No duplicates.

items.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

creative_tabs.title: Creative Tabs

dropped_by.description: Mobs that are not ours (vanilla's) that drop the item, one entry per mob.
dropped_by.title: Dropped By

fire_resistant.description: Fire and lava do not destroy the dropped item, as netherite's.
fire_resistant.title: Fire Resistant

flavor.description: A flavor line in the tooltip: one sentence, no mechanics, at most 12 words (lore style guide).

gear.description: Optional: makes the item a wand or a piece of armor, with its fixed stats.

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

max_stack_size.description: Maximum stack size (1-99); gear always stacks to 1.
max_stack_size.title: Max Stack Size

recipe.description: Optional: the recipe that makes the item: shaped, shapeless or a smithing upgrade.
recipe.title: Recipe

use.description: What right-clicking the item does; one item is used up each time. unlearn_stat_points: every spent stat point is unspent again (RLM-196).
use.title: Use

title: ItemDef
